summary: User story 'Bilderna beskärdes och det plockades ut bilder ur bilden' is fully verified. All 10 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_grow_and_dedupe.py pass (5 unit + 5 real-AI/integration). (A) UNIT grow_box: on the exact spec image (white 2000x2800, red rectangle [400,400,1600,1200] with white logo ellipse 900-1100 x 700-900, text block at y>=1300) starting from the inner logo box [250,450,321.4,550] grow_box() returned [142.9, 200.0, 430.0, 802.0] (image coords [400,400,1204,1604]) — ±4px of the panel and critically ymax=430 < text-start 464, so it did NOT grow into the paragraph text. Matches spec expectation '~[143,200,429,800]'. Also verified that if we start from the already-full panel box, grow_box leaves it in place (idempotent-ish). (B) UNIT dedupe_boxes: inner box dropped when nested in bigger (>=60% overlap); two side-by-side boxes both kept; bigger survives regardless of input order. (C) REAL AI (1 Gemini-fast OCR call via /uploads + wait for done): uploaded JPEG with red panel + white LOGO text + a separate noise/gradient photo + 28 lines of body text. Backend returned >=1 figure with https CommHub url + file_id. For every figure pair, inter(a,b)/area(a) < 0.6 (no nesting). A figure covers >=50% of the red-panel bbox in 0-1000 coords (y=[107,321], x=[100,450]) — confirming grow_box inside pipeline.refine_figures expanded the AI logo box to the whole red panel. (D) REGRESSION — manual recrop: PATCH /api/pages/{id}/figures/{fig_id} with box_2d=[50,60,250,300] stored the box EXACTLY (updated.box_2d == sent) and swapped url+file_id — refine_figures/grow_box is correctly NOT applied to manual CropEditor edits. (E) REGRESSION — ZIP export still contains bilder/*.jpg + bilder/bildtexter.txt. (F) Settings pinned speed_mode=fast + primary_provider=gemini pre- and post-test. (G) Frontend smoke on 390x844 mobile viewport: app loads clean (CopyThat home with KURSER empty state), no red-screen, no pageerror. Seed data (TEST_GROW_Course + TEST_GROW_Doc + 1 page + its figure) cleaned up via fixture teardown. Total paid AI calls this iteration: 1 (OCR only — within budget of 2).
critical_code_review_comments: pipeline.grow_box() uses a 500-wide downscale, so cost is O(500*700) in Python-level pixel loops — fine for typical pages. share() uses nested comprehension with px.load() which is C-fast; the max(w,h) iteration cap guarantees termination.

_bg_color() samples the outer 2px border; works well when the page truly has a uniform background (textbook pages, scans). On photos of pages with heavy shadow at edges the bg estimate could be wrong — pipeline.refine_figures still won't crash because grow_box only EXPANDS (never shrinks past the AI's box), so the fallback is 'returns the original AI box'. Safe.
pipeline.dedupe_boxes sorts by -area, so inner boxes are always compared against a larger kept box first — correct greedy order. The 0.6 threshold matches the user spec exactly.
pipeline.refine_figures correctly mutates each f['box_2d'] in-place inside asyncio.to_thread (safe since the thread owns the list), then dedupes.

pipeline.process_page calls refine_figures ONLY for auto-detected figures (both the OCR-pass and the detect_figures() fallback), never for manual add_figure/patch_figure routes — matches 'manual crops via CropEditor are NOT changed'.

ai.OCR_PROMPT and FIGURE_PROMPT now instruct the model to 'cover the whole coloured panel/shape' and 'never return a box that lies inside another box' — but this is advisory; refine_figures() is the hard guarantee via grow_box + dedupe_boxes.
Minor: _bg_color iterates 200*4 + 200*4 = 1600 pixel reads at Python level — negligible but could use ImageOps.crop + np.median for cleanliness. Not a bug.
crop_and_store() still clamps 0-1000 coords and adds 8/1000 padding (~0.8%), which combines gracefully with the grown box: a grown box that already touches the panel edge stays within clip bounds.
